comments:
597d8629:  ;This program is for pre-installation checks for the patch DGJ1P1.
 ;It ensures that the environment is correctly set up before proceeding with the installation.
fb6e5abf:  ;Entry point for the environmental check routine.
07ce4558: ;Initialize the XPDABORT variable to an empty string.
b2b0b469: ;Check for necessary variables: user ID (DUZ), programmer mode (DUZ(0)), current date (DT), and U variable set to '^'.
b5b0644f: ;Display a double asterisk line as a visual separator.
615cc472: ;Inform the user that the programming variables are not correctly set.
43f63377: ;Indicate that the installation has been aborted due to improper setup.
991ffe26: ;Ensure that version 1.0 of the Incomplete Records Tracking is preloaded.
5b3081b4: ;Display a double asterisk line as a visual separator for the version check section.
8f464e49: ;Message indicating the required version of Incomplete Records Tracking is not installed.
92620250: ;Indicate that the installation has been aborted due to the incorrect version.
1f5dcaf2: ;Indicate that the environment check is complete and successful.

c58fbf4e:  ;Abort installation process.
 ;This tag is reached if any checks fail.
0a10cdea: ;Set the XPDABORT flag to 2, indicating a forced stop of the installation.
